text:
Aisha (Release): Quick heads-up — planning to cut this week's release train tonight at 20:00 UTC. Short changelog below and a few rollout notes.
Tom (Infra): copy. which clusters are in scope?
Aisha (Release): core-serving (us-west-2), canary on us-east-1, and the new batching config rollout to dedicated pools.
Leila (Runtime): batching toggle is staged behind feature flag `batch_v2`. We'll enable on canary first. Perf looks good on short sequences.
Ben (QA): tests on canary passed except one flaky rerank test — investigating. Not blocking for canary but want a fix before prod.
Aisha (Release): noted. Can we do a quick hotfix if rerank regresses on prod?
Leila (Runtime): yes, we've got an emergency rollback that switches to `batch_v1` and pins kernel selection. 1-click revert in the console.
Aisha (Release): release freeze reminder: starting 00:00 UTC tomorrow we'll enter a 48h freeze for the SDK branch cut and docs sync. No non-critical feature merges until freeze lifted.
Tom (Infra): any infra migrations in this train?
Aisha (Release): small config migration for autoscaler policy names; it requires a short maintenance window (~5m). Scheduled for 20:10 UTC right after canary passes.
Ben (QA): add a quick smoke checklist for the maintenance window: model-serving smoke, token accounting, latency SLO check. I'll post the checklist now.
Ben (QA): checklist:
- send 10 synthetic requests to canary model
- verify 95p latency < 120ms
- check token billing counter increments
- run eval subset for rerank
Aisha (Release): thanks. ops-bot, please start the canary job at 20:00 UTC and tag with release 0.28.3-cutover.
ops-bot: Scheduled job created: canary-deploy 20:00 UTC -> release:0.28.3-cutover.
ReleaseBot: Deploy started on us-east-1 canary nodes. Logs: https://deploys.internal/release/1759005123
Leila (Runtime): canary up. Observability shows KV cache warmup taking ~30s. Latencies stable.
Ben (QA): rerank flaky test reproduced locally; pushed a patch to reduce timeout. PR: https://git.internal/pr/4456
Aisha (Release): good, we'll include that patch in the next minor if it doesn't make the freeze. Not required for tonight's core rollout.
Tom (Infra): autoscaler migration applied at 20:12 UTC, no errors.
Leila (Runtime): enabling `batch_v2` on canary now.
ReleaseBot: Canary metrics: token throughput +8%, median latency +3ms, 99p latency +12ms.
Ben (QA): smoke checklist all green except 99p slightly above target by 2ms — acceptable for now.
Aisha (Release): rolling to prod in staggered waves: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%, 10m between waves. If 99p exceeds threshold for 2 consecutive waves, automatic rollback triggers.
Tom (Infra): Confirming rollback automation in place. Alerting channel set to #eng-oncall and #incidents.
Leila (Runtime): watch for KV cache churn on long-context sessions — we've added extra monitoring.
Aisha (Release): final note for clients: we'll mark the release in the changelog and send a short line to #product once fully rolled. Avoid merging anything behind the freeze.
Ben (QA): will monitor the rollout and report back at 21:00 UTC.
ops-bot: Production rollout started: wave 1 (10%). See dashboard: https://dash.internal/releases/0.28.3-cutover
ReleaseBot: Wave 1 completed successfully.
Leila (Runtime): wave 2 in progress. Minor spike on a single node, autoscaler balanced it out.
Ben (QA): wave 2 smoke checks passing.
Aisha (Release): wave 3 go/no-go?
Tom (Infra): go from infra.
Leila (Runtime): go from runtime.
Ben (QA): go from QA.
ops-bot: Wave 3 completed. Wave 4 (100%) starting in 10m.
Aisha (Release): reminder — release freeze active. If you need an exception, @me with justification.
ReleaseBot: Full rollout succeeded. Release 0.28.3-cutover is live.
Aisha (Release): huge thanks — special shoutout to Leila and Tom for the autoscaler work. I'll post a short postmortem if we see any regressions.
Ben (QA): one follow-up: rerank patch merged to main. Will schedule a quick regression run tomorrow morning.
Leila (Runtime): monitoring looks stable 30m post-roll, no regressions so far.
Aisha (Release): closing the thread — notes will be added to the weekly changelog doc. If anything pops, reopen here. :shipit:
